name: guns
label: Guns / firearms (Top X listicle)
description: Best X / Top 5 / Top 10 firearm and gear reviews, Amazon-affiliate driven.

product._comment: Where footage of the exact product may come from, in order. Stock is never used for a product: a generic gun clip would show the wrong model.
product._genericFallback: No media of the exact model: use moving footage of the same type of gun (revolver, pistol, shotgun, carbine, rifle) with the name in the lower third, instead of a name card.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).
stock._sectionHintCount: The first N hints name the product category (pistol, shotgun, rifle). Only these may be inferred from the whole product section when a line matches nothing itself.
stock._blocked: Stock results whose title/tags contain any of these are skipped.
stock._sources: B-roll providers in order. Photo sources (unsplash) are left out here on purpose: still B-roll makes a gun listicle feel like a slideshow. Unsplash is still used for product photos (product.sources).

llmGuidance: Niche: firearms and shooting gear reviews for an American audience. Product scenes must show the exact named model. Stock B-roll should be ranges, hunting, outdoors, gear on tables, holsters, ammo, gun stores; never violence, crime, war, people aiming at the camera, toys or airsoft. Use a title_card for every ranked item, at most one price_badge and one pros_cons per item, spec_card only with specs the narration states.
disclaimer: This video is for educational and entertainment purposes only. Always follow local, state, and federal laws regarding the safe handling, purchase, and ownership of firearms.

qa._comment: Share of running time that may be still images/cards (product photos move with zoom/pan, but too many feel like a slideshow).

official._comment: Brand -> manufacturer site. Product photos are taken from the product page found in the site sitemap (sites that answer 403 are skipped).
